name: AUDIT V14 5 BATCH VO1-30 - PART BERURUTAN OTOMATIS
mapping_rule: Sort available Part numbers ascending. Button 1 takes first 3 available Parts to VO1-6; button 2 next 3 to VO7-12; button 3 next 3 to VO13-18; button 4 next 3 to VO19-24; button 5 next 3 to VO25-30.
close_behavior: Every batch button closes currently tracked V14 VO windows before opening its own VO group.
dynamic_open: Only open 2 VO windows for each Part actually assigned to the selected batch.
